assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: landscape 16:9 opaque 2D pixel-art gameplay screenshot mockup for the Korean folklore fantasy expedition roguelike RPG "Drift Chart".
Primary request: Design an actual readable in-game play screen, not a poster. The core decision is selecting an observation site to resolve a contradictory chart before committing a voyage.
Style/medium: exceptionally crisp hand-placed-looking pixel art, visible square pixels and neat limited-color clusters, small readable sprite silhouettes, Korean folklore fantasy, wooden boat and traditional village forms, top-down 2D gameplay, no 3D rendering.
Composition: about 65 percent on the LEFT is the explorable top-down turquoise archipelago; about 35 percent on the RIGHT is the navigation parchment grid UI. Bottom strip with exactly three small party portraits and simple supplies pips. No giant title banner.
Scene: a player's wooden sailboat in turquoise water, distinct island with lush peach trees and oversized peaches, an island village whose houses have huge crab-shell roofs, and a tiny-people island with visibly miniature homes and tiny inhabitants. Warm inviting exploratory mood. A glowing verified coastal observation beacon marks one location.
Navigation UI: parchment grid with several partly uncertain tiles and question-mark pictograms. Exactly two alternative dotted routes from the same sailboat marker toward distinct observation sites. Two small conflicting map fragments are pinned adjacent inside the navigation area, one depicts a passage open, the other a reef blocking the same passage. The verified beacon glows on the main map and has a matching confirmed symbol in the parchment. Use clear cyan versus amber dotted routes.
Text if needed, ONLY these short labels: "CHART", "OBSERVE", "VERIFY". Use icons and pips for other information.
Constraints: fully opaque, wide 16:9 composition, clear playable spatial layout, bright mysterious neighborly mood, no combat cards, no weapons, no photorealism, no painterly brushwork, no isometric 3D, no logos or watermark, no dense text or paragraphs, no Korean lettering.
